title: Quiet unattended mode: decide, log, keep going

short.lead: Unattended mode still stops. This plan closes 11 ways it can ask or quit, after two independent reviews. I need one approval line from you.
short.hint: Tap a step to see it.
items: Only choices that change how something looks or what it does come to you. Every other choice I make myself, write down, and carry on. Once a goal is set, I work its steps to the end.

items.alt: A choice about look or function goes to you; any other choice I decide and log
items.caption: Who decides what

items: Keep going until the goal is met
The plan becomes numbered steps. A check on every reply blocks the stop while a step is open, in every mode. A second loop outside the session restarts it if it quits.

items.alt: A goal check blocks the stop until the goal is met
items.caption: Why it stops today and what changes

items: Each decision goes into one file as I make it. You first see them on the QA page, once everything is built and tested.

items.alt: Decisions are written quietly during build and test, then shown on the QA page
items.caption: When you see the decisions

items: Your approval is recorded as one line in the decisions log.

changes: changed
Rule text tells me to ask, wait or stop
Ask only about look or function; never stop to ask
Many lines tell me to ask, wait or hand over. After the change, only choices about how something looks or what it does come to you. A dependency, data format or API change counts as function.

Where: rules/show-dont-tell.md:5, 11, 12; rules/house-rules.md:91; rules/detail/clear-writing.md:19, 61; rules/detail/handover-command.md:28, 51, 163; rules/detail/commit-branches.md:50; rules/standards/coding-philosophy.md:58; agents/builder.md:11, 18; core.py:1546, 1610.
Everything else I decide, log, and carry on.
Hard stops stay yours: a licence, a login, a purchase, a deletion, money, secrets, other people.
new
One test for nobody is there
Unattended, bypass, auto and dontAsk all count as nobody present
Today only unattended and bypass are recognised, so auto mode still asks and waits. One helper replaces every separate test.
Where: core.py:2794, 3840; safe_git.py:1375, 1638, 1935; bigfiles.py:150.
The prompt timer refuses any permission prompt after its timeout when nobody is present.
Auto mode has its own safety check I cannot rewrite, so overnight runs use bypass.
changed
Unattended switches the design loop off
Unattended keeps the design loop and runs it itself
The design loop stays on. I design, decide, have a helper review the plan, approve it, build the steps and hand over a QA page.
Where: core.py:2723, 2737, 2850; design_loop.py:2952; hook.py:122.
Handover comes back on with these checks: evidence, commit, deviation, QA page, changelog, decision log.
Off: editor, page cap, plain summary, send page, builders, issues.
new
Self-approval a hook records
The hook approves, only when a real review exists

Today only your typed message moves the stage. A hook function, not a command I can run, records auto-approval. It needs: the launcher or your typed switch, a stored reviewer verdict for this page's hash, and a build plan with a done-when command per step.
Where: design_loop.py:621, 1157, 1418, 1476; make_page.py:609.
Agent writes to house-rules-mode.json are refused, so I cannot switch unattended on myself.
QA passed and Close approved stay yours only. Self-approval never updates the other-branch lock.
new
A step list I cannot edit
Steps live in a guarded file; the hook runs each check

At approval the hook copies the steps from the reviewed build plan into the guarded stage file with a hash. A step is done only when its done-when command exits 0. I cannot mark it done or shrink the list.
Changes go only through ledger_note.py deviate, shown on the QA page.
A step is parked only with a hard-stop category, and still counts as not done on the QA page.
The open steps are re-injected at session start, resume and compaction, and in every stop block.
new
A check on every stop
One deterministic check, one shared counter, no model needed
Today the check fires on two phrases and blocks twice. The new check reads the step file on every stop, even with no reply text. A missing step file while a goal is active counts as open.
NEEDS YOU ends the stop only when every open step is marked needs-you.

overnight.sh sets CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP to 0 and the plugin keeps one counter. At most one model judge per stop, used only when the reply claims the last step is done; it can block but never end the run.
new
Look or function choices with nobody there
Take the safe default, park it, list it first on QA

A choice about look or function cannot wait for you, and I must not stop. I take the safest reversible default and log it as your call. Attended, a reply ending QUESTION FOR YOU: is allowed, and a new message from you clears any block.
The ledger gets a new row type, C for choice, via ledger_note.py decide.
QA lists your-call rows and auto-approvals first, with why and how to undo.
Outside the design loop the ledger is named after the branch, with / changed to -.
new
A restart loop outside the session
overnight.sh becomes a headless loop that resumes the session

Today overnight.sh starts Claude once and sits idle after any stop. The new version starts with a fixed session id and resumes it by id after any stop, never by most recent session. The resume text is marked relayed, so it can never count as your approval.
Rate and usage limits: wait until the reset time, without using a restart.
Ends into QA when every step is done or parked; a last short run builds the QA page.
Limits: 24 hours and 5 restarts with no step closed. The web app has no loop; it relies on Claude Code's /goal and the step check, and is unverified.
changed
Decisions shown too early
Decisions appear only on the QA page
Guard refusals, denied questions and the unattended note all tell me to report in the reply or the final report. They change to: write it to the ledger, say nothing, continue with the next open step.
Where: safe_git.py:1584, 1620; core.py:2800, 2958; tools/overnight.sh:4.
A hard stop marks its step needs-you and I continue with the others.
ExitPlanMode is allowed when nobody is present, and logged as a decision.
changed
Gates that freeze a run nobody can answer
Skipped when nobody is present

With the loop on, a reply asking a question holds edits, unreadable GitHub refuses them, and unlabelled issues refuse them. Nobody can clear any of these. A pull request opens only when every step is done or parked.
The step list, not a pull request, moves Build to QA.
In-flight speed-first build: this plan waits for it to leave Build.
changed
Earlier decisions reversed
Twelve earlier decisions are reversed, each logged
Each gets a dated entry in docs/6-decisions/Decisions.md and a pointer left in the old one.
Includes: approval only from your message, one cap of two blocks, unattended or bypass only, relaxed credit check.
Tests to change: checks/core.py, checks/design_loop.py, checks/safe_git.py; new ones for self-approval, the step file and the shared counter.
choices: Do you approve this plan as written?
Tell me what, in your own words.
I recommend A. Any hole left open would still let a run stop.

wrapup.summary: Eleven rule, hook and launcher problems (plus twelve reversals) make unattended mode ask or quit, and this plan replaces them with decide, log, and keep going.
wrapup.changing: Rules, hooks, guards, the step file, ledger_note.py, make_page.py, hooks.json, tools/overnight.sh, the tests, the docs and the changelog.
wrapup.blocking: Your approval line; no code is touched until you send it.
wrapup.next: After you approve, I write a build plan page with a done-when command per step, then build. I test a real headless session before the QA page.
